name: Data Dictionary and DSS Instance datasets test project
description:
This is an example project designed to demonstrate the following DSS plugins:
[Data Dictionary Agent Plugin](https://github.com/THE-MOLECULAR-MAN/dss-plugin-data-dictionary-agent/releases/)

[Datasets about Dataiku Instance Plugin](https://github.com/THE-MOLECULAR-MAN/dss-plugin-xzibit/releases/)

It includes:
* uses of all the datasets provided by the Datasets about Dataiku Instance Plugin
* a scenario that runs the Generate Descriptions macro
* an agent built to query information about this DSS instance

The data processing flow consists of two main zones: "Internal Stat datasets" and "Test Plugin."

The "Internal Stat datasets" zone is focused on processing and caching data related to job executions, software project commits, and scenario runs. It takes three input datasets: "jobs," "commits," and "scenario_runs," each containing detailed information about their respective domains. The flow processes these datasets to produce three output datasets: "jobs_cached," "commits_cached," and "scenario_run_cached." These output datasets serve as cached versions of the input data, retaining essential information while optimizing it for faster access and analysis. This zone is designed to streamline access to critical execution and change data, making it readily available for further analysis or reporting.

The "Test Plugin" zone is designed to manage and synchronize various datasets related to a data science platform's infrastructure, projects, and user management. It takes several input datasets, each representing different aspects of the platform, such as system connections, projects, code environments, datasets, plugins, applications, clusters, recipes, and users. The primary function of this zone is to ensure that the data within these input datasets is up-to-date and synchronized. The output consists of several cached datasets, each corresponding to a specific aspect of the platform, such as projects, plugins, clusters, datasets, recipes, connections, users, applications, and code environments. This zone ensures that the platform's data is current and reliable, supporting efficient management and operation of the data science infrastructure.

Overall, the flow is designed to optimize data access and synchronization across different domains, ensuring that critical information is readily available and up-to-date for analysis, reporting, and efficient platform management.

shortDesc:

It has an agent to query internal DSS datasets.
